notes.title: Ghoul Smash - Update 15
notes.notes:
[h2]Pumpkin Smash[/h2]
Gather your gear and face off against the Pumpkin Creatures within the Eternal Battleground! Collect Candy and combine it with the Pumpkin Heart to create exciting new equipment. Pumpkin Smash is an event for October 2024 for Ghoul Smash.

While it is an event, it is [b]NOT[/b] time-limited, meaning it will always be available.

Features:
[list]
[*] 1x Armor Set (Helmet, Armor, Gloves, and Boots)
[*] 1x Weapon
[*] 1x Trinket
[*] A new way to modify encounters in the Eternal Battleground
[*] A new Atlas Core Encounter
[*] 3x New Enemies
[*] 1x New Boss
[/list]

[h2]Items & Equipment[/h2]
Added a new weapon type: Punchers
Punchers specialize in increasing the damage of your default collisions with no additional spirit cost. They are versatile, like wands, meaning you can wield them in your offhand.
There are a total of 6 puncher-type weapons added to the game in this update. You can acquire most from It That Bargains; however, the Tier 6 version must be found within the Eternal Battleground.

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted additional sounds with audio pitching and reduced the volume of more common sound effects.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Captain Blackbear'd wouldn't end his turn properly. For real, this time.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nexus Wand wouldn't launch a torrent of projectiles.
[*] Fixed a bug where boosters wouldn't trigger when you hit the boost limit. Boosters now always give a Speedboost.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you for supporting Ghoul Smash![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2435910/Ghoul_Smash/

notes.title: Ghoul Smash v12 - Defense Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Story[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Events with the Envoy.
[*] Added Events with Sisters of Concordance.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new achievement.
[/list]

[h1]Save Slots[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added save slots.
[/list]

[h1]Defense Rework[/h1]
[h2]Damage Reduction[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maximum Damage Reduction is now capped at 80% baseline.
[*] Maximum Damage Reduction can be increased to a maximum of 96%.
[*] Reduced the values of Damage Reduction on Affixes.
[*] Almost every item with Damage Reduction has been adjusted.
[*] Adjusted Barricade Keystone.
[/list]
[h2]Dodge[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maximum Dodge is now 80% baseline.
[*] Maximum Dodge is capped at 96%.
[*] Reduced the values of Dodge on Affixes.
[*] Almost every item with Dodge has been adjusted.
[*] Adjusted Windrunner Keystone.
[/list]
[h2]Glancing Hits[/h2]
Dodge has very much been a live or die situation; and requires a secondary defense to even be viable. To help alleviate this issue, Glancing Hits have been added.
When you fail to Dodge an attack, the attacker's attack roll will be unluckily rolled against your Dodge Chance. If your Dodge Chance now beats the new attacker unlucky roll, damage received will be halved as a glancing hit. This will apply before Damage Reduction.
[h2]Barrier[/h2]
[h3]Barrier Regeneration[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base Barrier Regeneration is now 10%.
[*] Maximum Barrier Regeneration is 100%.
[*] Every 5 Intelligence grants 1% Barrier Regeneration.
[*] Adjusted Weaveborn Keystone.
[/list]
[h1]Combat[/h1]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] All enemies now deal 30% less Damage.
[*] All enemies have 30% more Constitution.
[/list]
[h2]Mini Bosses[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer guarantee a Rare Drop Table drop.
[*] Can now be toggled on or off after getting the upgrade.
[/list]
[h2]Eternal Battleground[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemy scaling in each tier has been reduced significantly.
[/list]
[h2]Buff Plates[/h2]
[list]
[*] They now trigger when you slide over them, like boost plates.
[*] Effects have been reduced.
[*] They can only activate once per round.
[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Text now pops a bit more during combat
[/list]
[h1]Interslice[/h1]
[h2]Urwood[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max Level Upgrade has been removed. This will be added back at a later point for Act 3.
[*] Character who have purchased this upgrade will retain it.
[/list]
[h2]Aetherflux[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cost of Skill Points has increased SIGNIFICANTLY
[*] An in-game method has been added to help alleviate this.
[/list]
[h2]Storage[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Loadout Slots
[*] You gain an additional loadout slot every 2 upgrades.
[/list]
[h2]Panel[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the Vanity Menu to replace the transmog menu,
[/list]
[h1]Items & Equipment[/h1]
[h2]Parrying Daggers[/h2]
[h3]Parry[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now grants a flat +20% Dodge and -20% Damage Reduction.
[/list]
[h3]Riposte[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now grants a flat +20% Dodge and -20% Damage Reduction.
[/list]
[h3]Serrated Parry[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now grants a flat +20% Dodge and -20% Damage Reduction.
[/list]
[h2]Swords[/h2]
[h3]Stab[/h3]
[list]
[*] On kill, you have a 25% (Previously 100%) chance to launch a slicing wave towards the nearest enemy that has a 100% chance to Wound.
[/list]
[h3]Vampiric Stab[/h3]
[list]
[*] On kill, you have a 25% (Previously 100%) chance to launch a slicing wave towards the nearest enemy that has a 100% chance to Wound.
[/list]
[h3]Fury[/h3]
[list]
[*] On kill, you have a 25% (Previously 100%) chance to launch a slicing wave towards the nearest enemy that has a 100% chance to Wound.
[/list]
[h2]Lance[/h2]
[h3]Joust[/h3]
[list]
[*] While moving you gain a charge every 0.5 (previously 1) seconds up to 10 (Previously 5).
[*] Now Has:Gain 1 Jump Boost
[/list]
[h3]Charge Thrust[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has: Gain 1 Jump Boost
[/list]
[h2]Mace[/h2]
[h3]Crush[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now deals the additional hit at the end of the launch.
[/list]
[h3]Divine Crush[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now deals the additional hit at the end of the launch.
[/list]
[h2]Affixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed the following affixes,
[*] Hybrid Dexterity & Strength
[*] Hybrid Strength & Intelligence
[*] Hybrid Intelligence & Dexterity
[*] Hybrid Pierce & Accuracy
[*] Hybrid Damage & Critical Chance
[*} Likely a temporary change, going to keep the simplicity for now.
[*] Buffed Constitution affixes.
[*] Buffed Spirit affixes.
[*] Buffed Barrier affixes.
[*] Nerfed Pierce affixes slightly.
[*] Nerfed Accuracy affixes slightly.
[*] Nerfed Damage Reduction affixes slightly.
[*] Nerfed Dodge affixes affixes slightly.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash - Version 11
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[h2]Buff Plates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buff Plates now randomly spawn during encounters. There are a total of 7 different Buff Plates, each with their own unique effect. To learn more about them, consult the guide in-game.
[*] Act 1 has had Buff Plates added to some of the encounters. Act 2 and Endgame will be visited at a later time.
[/list]

[h2]Combat Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bare-bones combat tutorial has been added to the Atlas. Offers a unique reward and a head start for the campaign.
[/list]
[h2]
Equipment & Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new rare trinket to the Shop.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed how text is displayed on Legendary items to the intended color. The old color will be used for Starlight Items.
[*] Made the Right-Click brake much more powerful during combat.
[*] While braking, the player can no longer gain Speedboosts to make it more consistent.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[h2]Aetherflux[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a help button.
[/list]
[h2]The Atlas[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added lock icons to areas that have not been completed yet instead of them just appearing.
[*] Added a help button to the Atlas Crucible.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can no longer interact in combat while a window (such as Attributes) is open.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash - Version 9
notes.notes:
In Preparation for the Steam NEXTFEST in June, Ghoul Smash has recieved some updates!

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[h2]Linux / Steam Deck[/h2]
[list]
[*] The first build with Linux support has been implemented.
[/list]

[h2]Save Backups[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ghoul Smash now includes a backups folder located in %appdata%/roaming/Ghoul_Smash. After each game session, a backup of your current save will be created, up to a maximum of 10 backups. The oldest backup will be automatically deleted if there are already 10 saved. Note that this folder will be removed during forced Save Wipes or upon player death in Hardcore mode.
[*] To load a backup, simply copy and paste your desired backup into the main /Ghoul_Smash/ folder and rename it to 'saveData.sav', overwriting any existing save data.
[/list]

[h2]Guide[/h2]
[list]
[*] The first iteration of an in-game guide has been introduced, and it will receive continual updates.
[/list]

[h2]Items & Equipment[/h2]
New Weapon Type: Maces
[list]
[*] 7 new weapons
[*] 2 new armor sets
[*] 3 new pairs of gloves
[/list]

[h3]Atlas Fragments[/h3]
A new area, The Hollows, has been added.

[h3]Crafting Materials[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1 new whetstone
[*] 3 new shards, sparks, and stars
[/list]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new enemy types
[*] 1 new mini-boss
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tooltips to various elements.
[*] Reworked the Attributes Window for improved readability and added additional information.
[*] Moved the Class Changing Buttons to the Aetherflux.
[*] Right-clicking now allows for points to be refunded in the Aetherflux.
[*] Right-clicking also enables quick unequipping and equipping of items when no other window is open.
[*] Reworked the Crafting Window and streamlined the dropping of materials to make crafting quicker and less cumbersome.
[*] Skill gems now provide information about the associated skill.
[/list]

[h2]Critical Chance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Critical Chance has been made harder to acquire, making the Celestial Barrage Keystone more unique.
[*] Affixes with Critical Chance have had their values halved.
[*] Most rings and equipment with Critical Chance have been reduced.
[/list]

[h2]Keystones[/h2]
[h3]Carnage[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now leech 0.25% (previously 2%) of your Skill Damage as Constitution.
[/list]

[h3]Astral Battery[/h3]
[list]
[*] You gain damage equal to 25% of your Spirit (previously 500% of your Spirit Cost).
[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] The maximum reduction in an enemy's Damage Reduction with Pierce is now capped at -10%.
[*] Enemies now have a maximum Dodge chance of 95%, ensuring a minimum 5% chance to hit them even if their Dodge chance exceeds 95%. Accuracy is still advantageous; however, to reduce their Dodge chance below 95%, a minimum of 46 Accuracy is required in the example provided.
[/list]

[h2]Skills[/h2]
[h3]Thrust[/h3]
[list]
[*] All variants of Thrust have been updated to reduce the minimum enemy damage reduction to -20% and now include Pierce as a built-in feature.
[/list]

[h3]Ball Lightning[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Ball Lightning should have summoned a maximum of 2 Lightning Orbs; now it correctly summons up to 3 Lightning Orbs.
[/list]

[h3]Energy Leech[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5% (previously 2%) of your Default Collision Damage is now leeched as Barrier.
[/list]

[h3]Energy Siphon[/h3]
[list]
[*] 0.1% (previously 0.5%) of your Skill Damage is now leeched as Barrier.
[/list]

[h3]Siegebolt[/h3]
Siegebolt outperformed many of the other T6 Weapons with no investment required. It has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Reduced the base damage to 40 (previously 60) of each projectile.
[*] Reduced the base damage of the Shrapnel to 30 (previously 60).
[/list]

[h3]Resonance[/h3]
[list]
[*] You now gain x0.25 (previously x0.5) Damage at the start of your turn if your Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence are equal.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Character Model appearing when in the Options Menu.
[*] Fixed the Molten Golem encounter from dropping Tier 1 Items.
[*] Fixed the Tooltip for Trident Dagger.
[*] Resolved an issue where selecting a resolution above your monitor's capabilities caused the cursor to lock, requiring manual adjustment of the resolution via systemdata.ini in %appdata%/roaming/Ghoul_Smash.
[*] Fixed a soft lock that occurred when attempting to open the Attributes Window while selecting mode at the beginning of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash Patch Notes v0.7.8.9
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Skills will now save their toggled status upon closing the game.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed Royal Boots Speed value to be 12. (Previously 120). Using a Confluence Orb on an existing pair of Royal Boots will update them to the intended value.
[/list]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Steam Button to the Main Menu and Options Menu that takes you to the Ghoul Smash Store Page.
[*] Added Tips to the Interslice Hub. You can toggle them off inside the Options Menu.
[*] Hitting Spacebar while in most menus will now close the menu. This functionality has been added for future controller support.
[*] Early Controller Support, you can test it out by booting Ghoul Smash in Big Picture mode and using default controller support through steam.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash Patch Notes v0.7.8.8
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Amount of Speedboosts you can gain outside of Boost Pads per turn is now limited to 10. (Some items such as the Spear allow 20 Speedboosts.)
[*] Changed the text color of skill damage.

Normal Hit = White
2x Critical Hit = Yellow
3x Critical Hit = Orange
4x Critical Hit = Red
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Burning Men would keep burning the player on collision. (The burn is supposed to only trigger once per round).
[/list]

[h2]Skills[/h2]
[h3]Thrust[/h3]
[list]
[*] Speedboost on attack has been reduced to 0.15 (Previously 0.25)
[/list]

[h3]Bash[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bash has been reworked to make it all about the Bash Projectile Target. Its' new mechanics are as follows:
Turns the first enemy you collide with into a Bash Target and yourself into a bounce pad. The bash target gains damage each time it collides with another object. Damage is dealt to the Bash Target at the end of your turn.
[/list]

[h3]Flail[/h3]
[list]
[*] Speedboost on kill is now 0.25 (Previously 0.15)
[/list]

notes.title: Ghoul Smash Patch Notes v0.7.8.6
notes.notes:
[h1][b]User Interface[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some Strings and typos with items, equipment, tooltips, and descriptions.
[*] You can now transfer things with Right Click into and out of the Atlas Crucible.
[/list]

[h1][b]Combat[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now change equipment during combat. (Surely this won't have any bugs....)
[*] Trinket Skills now function properly.
[*] Mimic Rare Drop is now significantly less rare (1% -> 25%)
[*] Fixed a bug where Skill Damage would appear where the skill is currently located and not where the target is located.
[*] The Rat King's animation speed is now fixed.
[/list]

[h1][b]Skills[/b][/h1]
[h2]Cleave[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scaling is now A (Previously S)
[*] Cleave now summons a swirling vortex that deals damage to enemies inside, launching them if they survive. Enemies killed by the vortex give a Speedboost.
[/list]

[h2]Thrust[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gives a Speedboost every time the spear stabs.
[*] The Speedboost amount has been increased (+40%)
[*] Spears attack faster (+20%)
[*] Spears have more range (+30%)
[/list]

[h2]Bash[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reverted the Knockback effect to the old method to make it not go straight horizontal and vertical so often.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Deity Fruit now costs more in the shop.
[*] Jury now has more damage.
[*] Styx now has more damage.
[*] Confluence Orbs now work on Rings and Necklaces.
[*] A new item called the Catalyst has been added to the drop pool at Tier 5. The Catalyst will upgrade an item's Tier to 5.
[/list]
